choice: Answer only Host 127.0.0.1 or localhost on our port (DNS rebinding). POST endpoints need the page's Origin or none, Content-Type application/json, and no Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site (CSRF). /api/open accepts only plain https://linear.app links and answers 502 when /usr/bin/open fails or hangs. The page has a Content Security Policy and renders Linear text with textContent; every response also sends `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`. /api/state names the program ("app": "cmux-linear-sidebar") so the scripts can tell it from another program on the port.
context: Any page open in the user's browser can send requests to 127.0.0.1.
rejected: The Host check alone (an earlier version): a cross-site no-cors POST could open any linear.app URL in the user's browser or exhaust the API key's rate limit through /api/refresh. frame-ancestors in the page's meta CSP (browsers ignore it there).
title: Harden the localhost server against other websites
